messages:
Maya P: Drafting a playbook for model retirement incentives + migration runway. Need a checklist, benchmarks, launch gates, and customer incentive ops. Starting thread to capture ideas. TL;DR: proposing a default 8-week runway + staged canary.

Arun K: Who owns this end-to-end? Product sets policy, but Eng needs the rollback hooks. Need a clear owner for customer comms + billing.

Priya S: Benchmarks suggestions:
- Eval pass rate >= 95% on core prompt set
- Latency regression <= 5% P95
- Embedding drift (cosine) <= 0.03 vs pinned model
- Token-accuracy checks for extraction prompts: F1 delta <= 2 pts
If any fail, block rollout.

Jordan: Migration incentives:
- $ credits (one-time) up to 10% of last 3mo spend or $5k, whichever smaller
- Extended pin window (30d) during migration at no charge
- Free migration support (2h SE office hours)
These have to be opt-in and tied to the customer migration ticket.

Sam C: Comms play:
- Default notice = 60 days for self-serve customers
- Enterprise = 180 days + account manager sync
- Provide a migration guide + compatibility matrix + sample prompts
- Offer a "compatibility shim" for customers hitting regressions

Maya P: Launch gates (proposal):
1) Internal canary: 0.5% of traffic for 7 days, monitor errors/latency/quality
2) External canary: 3-5 customers on opt-in pilot for 14 days
3) Eval suite stable: no regressions for 48h post-canary
4) Ops checklist clear: capacity reserved + fallback route configured
Rollback criteria: sustained P95 latency increase >10% or eval fail rate >3% over baseline.

Arun K: Ops checklist draft:
- Reserve Dedicated capacity for canary window
- Configure smart routing fallbacks (model variant & region)
- CI job: `redwood-eval run --suite migrate-core --model new-v --thresholds file.json`
- Run smoke tests: auth, streaming, tool-calls
- Update routing policies and traffic-shifts in infra repo

Priya S: Quick local example to run the eval suite:

```
# run on local harness
./bin/redwood-eval --model new-v2 --suite core-migration --out report.json
cat report.json | jq '.results | {pass_rate,latency_p95,embed_drift}'
```

Maya P: Measuring customer impact to decide incentives:
- Active tenants using model in last 90d
- Revenue-facing endpoints (weigh more)
- Number of pinned versions
Suggested formula: incentive = min($5k, 0.1 * avg_3mo_spend)

Jordan: Operational note: For customers that decline migration, we need a formal sunset contract clause (safety net), and an exception flow for pinning at extra cost.

catalog-bot: Canary scheduled: canary-window start=1765552000 end=1765553380 (automated)
